data.description: Initial data for the tensor. Can be a list, tuple, NumPy ``ndarray``, scalar, and other types. dtype (:class:`torch.dtype`, optional): the desired data type of returned tensor. Default: if ``None``, infers data type from :attr:`data`.

device.description: the device of the constructed tensor. If None and data is a tensor then the device of data is used. If None and data is not a tensor then the result tensor is constructed on the current device.
